dotnet-core-test

Dynamic, version-agnostic UI-driven conversion of the manual dotnet-core-test-source.csv scenario. Before starting, scripts/dotnet/aspnet_majors.py collect runs 'dotnet --list-runtimes' to discover every installed Microsoft.AspNetCore.App major version (8, 9, 10, 11, ... -- whatever is actually present on the machine), then the full scenario (scaffold via 'dotnet new console -o c{major} -f net{major}.0', open in VS, add a class library + project reference, edit code, breakpoint debugging, IntelliSense/lightbulb, hover, squiggle/Error List, CodeLens references, Go To Implementation, Pack, Publish, Properties, and cleanup) repeats once per discovered major version. The ONLY command-line/CLI step per iteration is the 'dotnet new console' scaffold; every other action is driven through the Visual Studio UI.
